title: Touhou Bunkachou ~ Shoot the Bullet - Tengu's Notebook ~ Mysterious Note
description:
The calm and mysterious title screen theme from the 9.5th Touhou game, Shoot the Bullet.

Probably best suited for title screens or any other generally calm areas. It's also got the Theme of Eastern Story motif most Touhou title screen games have.

Note that this port will not play nicely with noise SFX due to the prolonged seashore-y noise in the background.
